title: Make the website season-aware
description:
The website currently shows a single flat leaderboard and games list with no concept of seasons or tournaments. Now that we have season state (data/season.json) and tournament files (data/tournaments/), the website needs to be updated:

- The leaderboard page should prominently show the *current* season's standings, with the ability to view previous seasons and their tournaments.
- The games list should be filterable by season and by tournament vs free-play.
- Previous season tournaments should be viewable with bracket results.
- Copy throughout the site needs rewriting to reference seasons (e.g., 'Season 1 Leaderboard' instead of just 'Leaderboard').
- The home page should call out the current season phase (free-play or tournament).
- The leaderboard generation (generate_leaderboard.py / leaderboard.py) may need to partition by season so each season has independent Elo pools.

The season file is at data/season.json with format: {current_season, phase, tournament?}. Tournament files live at data/tournaments/season-N.json.
